crossRefs.note: seeing that you seek a proof of Christ who speaks in me; who toward you is not weak, but is powerful in you.
For he was crucified through weakness, yet he lives through the power of God. For we also are weak in him, but we will…
For this cause I write these things while absent, that I may not deal sharply when present, according to the authority…
For I am afraid that by any means, when I come, I might find you not the way I want to, and that I might be found by…

translations.web: But I hope that you will know that we aren’t disqualified.
translations.bsb: And I hope you will realize that we have not failed the test.
translations.kjv: But I trust that ye shall know that we are not reprobates.
